Say hello ↗

What do I need to use IntoSquare?+

Figma, Chrome, and a Squarespace 7.1 site using Fluid Engine. IntoSquare has two companions: a Figma plugin to copy your design and a Chrome extension to bring it into Squarespace.

Can I still edit everything in Squarespace?+

Supported elements become native Squarespace blocks. Edit text, move blocks, change spacing, and keep building in the normal editor. Unsupported details are flagged before export so you can adjust your design.

What happens to my images?+

The current version creates image placeholders with the layout in place. Add the final images through Squarespace after import. Automatic image upload is not included yet.

How does the mobile layout work?+

Auto Layout can become responsive Squarespace Stacks, with smaller mobile gaps and padding. If your desktop and mobile frames have different grouping or layer order, use Separate blocks to preserve the two arrangements.

Can I bring my fonts and colors too?+

Yes, with Pro. Copy typography and a five-color palette from Figma into native Squarespace Site Styles. Review changes before applying them across your site. Font availability can affect the result.

What happens if I stop paying?+

Your imported content stays in Squarespace and remains editable. The subscription controls future imports and Pro features; it does not lock the pages you already created.
